note: The hand-maintained registry `scripts/ops/dpdp-records-generate.mjs` checks against the schema. Every table the script detects as personal-data-bearing (a direct Prisma relation to User or Workspace) must have an entry here with a non-empty purpose and retention, or the generator fails. Add an entry here in the same commit that adds such a table. `purpose` is a ConsentPurpose value (`schema.prisma`) where the data collection is optional per D61 (analytics | memory | marketing | share_upload | affiliate); tables that back the product itself regardless of any granted consent are `service` (essential, D61 — never gated behind a consent toggle).

users.retention: Life of the account; erased on account deletion via the erasure cascade (05 §9).

admin_roles.retention: Life of the admin's account/role assignment.

admin_totp.retention: Life of the admin's account; rotated on TOTP reset.

consent_records.retention: Retained for the life of the account as evidence of what was granted/withdrawn and when (D61 Rule 3).

dsr_requests.retention: Retained indefinitely as the compliance record of rights requests and their resolution (Rule 14, 30-day response target).

identities.retention: Life of the account (OAuth/email identity linkage).

sessions.retention: Until logout or expiry; refresh-token family revoked on reuse detection (05 §8).

memberships.retention: Life of the membership; removed on workspace departure.

devices.retention: Life of the device registration (B08); revoked on deactivation.

license_keys.retention: Life of the licence; offline window 7 days, revocation list applied on next contact (05 §8).

api_keys.retention: Life of the key, until revoked.

folders.retention: Life of the workspace; cascades with project retention.

projects.retention: Plan's project retention window (05 §9): Free 7d, Starter 30d, Creator 90d, Studio/Agency 365d; purged after a 14-day warning (ProjectRetentionTask).

style_presets.retention: Life of the workspace (user-created style templates; system styles are not personal data).

fonts.retention: Life of the workspace; licence attestation kept alongside (D67).

memory_entries.retention: 12-month rolling TTL, refreshed on use, opt-in (D62); MemoryEntryExpiryTask purges expired rows.

comments.retention: Life of the share link/review thread (B15).

jobs.retention: Job row retained as the billing/usage record; `job_events.data` has its own 30-day retention (05 §9).

dlq.retention: Until replayed or discarded by an admin (A08b) — operational, not long-lived.

provider_submissions.retention: Same as the project's retention period; included in the erasure cascade (05 §9).

llm_outputs.retention: Same as the project's retention period.

subscriptions.retention: Life of the account plus applicable statutory billing-record retention (confirmed with the CA per H-18).

mandates.retention: Life of the mandate; retained after cancellation for dispute evidence per Razorpay's own retention.

invoices.retention: Life of the account plus applicable statutory financial-record retention (confirmed with the CA per H-18).

streak_experiments.retention: Life of the account; excluded for declared minors (D60).

affiliates.retention: Life of the affiliate relationship; off for declared minors.

audit_log.retention: Retained indefinitely as the security/administrative audit trail (THREAT-MODEL).

notifications.retention: Life of the account, or the in-app notification list's own retention policy.

webhook_endpoints.retention: Life of the workspace's integration configuration.

support_tickets.retention: Life of the account; diagnostics bundle is consent-gated per ticket (B12).
